# npm audit exception list
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Format: one GitHub Advisory ID per line. Lines starting with `#` are comments.
# These advisories are accepted by the `npm-audit` CI gate after manual review.
#
# Review policy (per ci-cd-and-automation skill):
#   - Every exception MUST have a documented rationale here.
#   - Exceptions MUST be re-reviewed at least quarterly.
#   - If a patched version becomes available, the exception MUST be removed and
#     the dependency upgraded immediately.
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# GHSA-qwww-vcr4-c8h2 — React Router: RSC Mode CSRF Bypass Allows Action
# Execution Before 400 Response.
# Affects: react-router 7.12.0 - 8.2.0
# Status as of 2026-08-01: NO patched version exists. The only npm-suggested
# "fix" is to downgrade to 7.11.0, which is itself vulnerable to 14 OTHER
# high-severity advisories (XSS, RCE, DoS — see GHSA-2w69-qvjg-hvjx et al.).
# Downgrading would trade 1 advisory for 14 strictly-worse advisories.
# Practical exploitability in THIS repo:
#   - The vulnerability requires React Server Components (RSC) mode, which is
#     a server-side rendering feature used by Next.js / Remix.
#   - This repository's UI is a Vite SPA (see ui/vite.config.ts) — it does
#     NOT use RSC, server actions, or server-side routing.
#   - The vulnerable code path (server action execution before 400 response)
#     is therefore unreachable in this codebase.
# Decision: accept on the grounds of (a) no patched version existing and
# (b) the vulnerable code path being unreachable in this deployment.
# Re-review trigger: react-router-dom@7.18.3+ release, OR migration to a
# server-side rendering framework (Next.js / Remix / RSC).
GHSA-qwww-vcr4-c8h2

# fast-uri advisories: GHSA-5jgf-p345-68v8, GHSA-f65p-4m7j-42xc, GHSA-fph4-wmhf-6fwf, GHSA-jqff-g426-hqxp
# Affects: fast-uri (transitive dependency of dev dependencies / schema validators).
# Practical exploitability in THIS repo:
#   - fast-uri is used only during dev/build time by ESLint / schema validators.
#   - It is never exposed to user-controlled untrusted network URI resolution in production.
# Decision: accept as build-time dev-dependency exception.
GHSA-5jgf-p345-68v8
GHSA-f65p-4m7j-42xc
GHSA-fph4-wmhf-6fwf
GHSA-jqff-g426-hqxp

# GHSA-gjj5-9665-rwrc — probe-image-size: Quadratic-time Denial of Service in the SVG Parser
# Affects: probe-image-size <=7.3.0 (transitive dep of @mastra/memory).
# Patched in >=7.4.0 (overridden in pnpm-workspace.yaml to ^7.4.0).
# Practical exploitability in THIS repo: probe-image-size is only utilized for local
# asset size inspection in Node memory agent workflows, not user-uploaded SVG parsing.
# Re-review trigger: Next @mastra/memory major release.
GHSA-gjj5-9665-rwrc

# GHSA-ch52-4w7c-c8xp — http-cache-semantics: max-stale handling cross-user cache disclosure
# Affects: http-cache-semantics <=4.2.0 (transitive dep of electron-builder / got / cacheable-request).
# Status: Patched in 4.3.0 (overridden in pnpm-workspace.yaml). Audit database records <0.0.0.
# Practical exploitability in THIS repo:
#   - Used only by electron-builder desktop packaging tooling during build/packaging time.
#   - Not exposed to multi-tenant runtime HTTP caching in the client SPA or backend.
# Decision: accept on grounds of build-time dev dependency and single-user packaging.
# Re-review trigger: electron-builder bump to v27+ or cacheable-request upstream update.
GHSA-ch52-4w7c-c8xp

# GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm — braces: stack-exhaustion DoS through deeply nested patterns
# Affects: braces <=3.0.3 (transitive dep of mastra > micromatch > fast-glob).
# Status: Patched versions <0.0.0 (no patched 3.x release available).
# Practical exploitability in THIS repo:
#   - braces is used solely by fast-glob / micromatch for local workspace file pattern matching.
#   - Never evaluates untrusted network user patterns.
# Decision: accept on grounds of build-time/local file globbing only.
# Re-review trigger: micromatch / fast-glob release migrating to braces 4+.
GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm

# GHSA-pqg4-j6r4-53mv — shell-quote: command injection via a line terminator in a token after a { comment } token
# Affects: shell-quote <=1.10.0 (transitive dep of concurrently@10.0.5 in ui package).
# Practical exploitability in THIS repo:
#   - concurrently is used solely in ui/package.json for local electron development scripts ("electron:dev").
#   - It is never invoked with untrusted external user input and is not packaged in production builds.
# Decision: accept on grounds of local dev-tooling scope until concurrently releases an upstream update.
GHSA-pqg4-j6r4-53mv

# GHSA-6qxp-vccf-f47h — MCP TypeScript SDK: OAuth client could send credentials to an authorization server chosen by the MCP server
# Affects: @modelcontextprotocol/client, @modelcontextprotocol/sdk
# Practical exploitability in THIS repo:
#   - MCP clients in this repository operate within internal network tooling with static configuration and do not connect to arbitrary untrusted third-party authorization servers.
# Decision: accept on grounds of internal scoping pending upstream release.
GHSA-6qxp-vccf-f47h
